prompt_short: I'm walking into a discovery call with the VP of Engineering at Acme Corp (SaaS) tomorro

assertions.text: Response contains all five strategy labels: Relationship, Purpose, Curiosity, Proof, and Time
assertions.evidence: Sections 1-5 labeled Relationship, Purpose, Curiosity, Proof light, Time & flow.

assertions.text: Response does NOT contain a clarifying question before the five intros
assertions.evidence: Opens with Context locked then Five intros—no questions before intros.

assertions.text: Response includes a recommendation or winner section naming one strategy
assertions.evidence: 'Recommendation' names Purpose as primary and Curiosity as runner-up.

assertions.text: Each intro begins with a greeting element (hi, good morning, thanks for, glad to)
assertions.evidence: Each numbered intro starts with 'Hi, I'm [Name]'.
